# Daily Briefing – Friday 3 July

Yesterday was a quiet one — no training logged and just 4,154 steps, so a genuine rest day. Calories burned came in at 2,288 kcal, almost exactly matching your 2,300 target, which is a solid balance. The main flag is sleep at only 5.5 hours — that's worth paying attention to.

The good news is your body is handling it well. HRV at 103ms sits within your 101–119ms baseline, resting HR is an excellent 48bpm, and stress is low at 28/100. You're recovered and ready — don't hold back today's session on account of yesterday.

That said, short sleep suppresses appetite hormones and increases cravings, so you'll likely be tempted to undereat protein or overeat carbs. Be intentional — front-load your 175g protein early in the day, starting with a solid breakfast, and prioritise 7–8 hours tonight. 48 days out, sleep is training.
